{{Top|leg}}
The '''Open Market''' was a bazaar located on the [[Bazaar Deck]] of the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']]. [[Alien/Legends|Alien]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] plied their wares from stands, bins, tents, and booths. Almost any common item was available for purchase in the Open Market.
